name: Ofluv Industrial Vehicles — Global SAP S/4HANA Transformation
description: Illustrative operating model for Ofluv Industrial Vehicles's global SAP S/4HANA programme. Twelve value streams across six domains. Order to Cash fully elaborated as reference stream. All other streams are structural stubs.

vs_order_to_cash.name: Order to Cash
vs_order_to_cash.description: End-to-end flow from customer order receipt through fulfilment, invoicing, and cash collection. Primary revenue realisation stream for Ofluv trucks and components across all sales regions.
vs_order_to_cash.terminalOutcome: Cash received and reconciled to order

vs_dealer_channel_mgmt.name: Dealer & Channel Management
vs_dealer_channel_mgmt.description: Management of Ofluv's global dealer network including onboarding, performance monitoring, incentive management, and channel conflict resolution.
vs_dealer_channel_mgmt.trigger: Dealer agreement signed or renewal due
vs_dealer_channel_mgmt.terminalOutcome: Dealer performing at target with active incentive alignment

vs_warranty_returns.name: Warranty & Returns
vs_warranty_returns.description: Processing of warranty claims, product returns, and credit notes across all markets. Interfaces with quality management and supplier recovery.
vs_warranty_returns.trigger: Warranty claim or return request submitted
vs_warranty_returns.terminalOutcome: Claim resolved and credit or replacement issued

vs_service_parts_planning.name: Service Parts Planning
vs_service_parts_planning.description: Demand-driven planning and distribution of spare parts to support global aftersales service commitments and dealer inventory targets.
vs_service_parts_planning.trigger: Parts demand signal from dealer or service network
vs_service_parts_planning.terminalOutcome: Parts available at point of service within committed lead time

vs_source_to_contract.name: Source to Contract
vs_source_to_contract.description: Strategic sourcing activities from spend analysis and supplier identification through RFx, negotiation, and contract execution for direct and indirect categories.
vs_source_to_contract.trigger: Sourcing need identified from category plan or requisition
vs_source_to_contract.terminalOutcome: Supplier contract active and available for purchase orders

vs_purchase_to_pay.name: Purchase to Pay
vs_purchase_to_pay.description: Operational procurement from purchase requisition through goods receipt, invoice matching, and supplier payment across all Ofluv entities.
vs_purchase_to_pay.terminalOutcome: Supplier invoice paid and goods or services received

vs_demand_supply_planning.name: Demand & Supply Planning
vs_demand_supply_planning.description: Integrated business planning process aligning market demand signals with production capacity, supply commitments, and inventory policy across all product lines.
vs_demand_supply_planning.trigger: Monthly IBP cycle or demand signal variance
vs_demand_supply_planning.terminalOutcome: Agreed production and supply plan published to all execution streams

vs_inbound_logistics.name: Inbound Logistics
vs_inbound_logistics.description: Movement of direct materials from suppliers to Ofluv manufacturing sites including transport management, customs, and goods receipt.
vs_inbound_logistics.terminalOutcome: Materials received, inspected, and available for production

vs_production_planning_execution.name: Production Planning & Execution
vs_production_planning_execution.description: Translation of the agreed supply plan into plant-level production orders, scheduling, shop floor execution, and completion reporting.
vs_production_planning_execution.terminalOutcome: Finished goods confirmed and transferred to warehouse

vs_quality_compliance.name: Quality & Compliance
vs_quality_compliance.description: Quality assurance across inbound materials, in-process production, and finished goods, including regulatory compliance for all markets.
vs_quality_compliance.trigger: Quality inspection triggered or non-conformance reported
vs_quality_compliance.terminalOutcome: Product certified compliant or non-conformance resolved

vs_financial_planning_consolidation.name: Financial Planning & Consolidation
vs_financial_planning_consolidation.description: Annual and rolling financial planning, budgeting, and group consolidation across all Ofluv entities and reporting segments.
vs_financial_planning_consolidation.trigger: Annual planning cycle or reforecast trigger
vs_financial_planning_consolidation.terminalOutcome: Approved group financial plan and consolidated forecast published

vs_financial_close_reporting.name: Financial Close & Reporting
vs_financial_close_reporting.description: Month-end and year-end close process including journal posting, reconciliation, statutory reporting, and external financial disclosure.
vs_financial_close_reporting.terminalOutcome: Financial statements published and filed within regulatory deadlines

act_otc_receive_validate_order.name: Receive and Validate Customer Order
act_otc_receive_validate_order.description: Capture inbound purchase orders from all channels and validate against customer master, pricing agreements, and product availability.

activities: Capture purchase order from EDI, portal, or manual channel
Validate order against current price list and discount agreements
Confirm product codes and configuration against SAP material master
Flag incomplete or exception orders for manual review
Acknowledge order receipt to customer within SLA
Validate customer sold-to and ship-to party assignments against SAP customer master
Confirm pricing conditions and agreement validity for the ordering entity
Check legal entity assignment and intercompany flag for cross-border orders
Flag incomplete customer master records for MDM remediation
Apply duplicate order detection against open order backlog

act_otc_check_credit_availability.name: Check Credit Limit and Availability
act_otc_check_credit_availability.description: Verify customer credit exposure against approved limit and release or block the order accordingly.

activities: Query current customer credit exposure in SAP FSCM
Compare open orders and receivables against approved credit limit
Release order automatically if within tolerance
Escalate blocked orders to credit manager for manual review
Update customer credit master following limit change decisions

act_otc_confirm_schedule_delivery.name: Confirm and Schedule Delivery
act_otc_confirm_schedule_delivery.description: Confirm available-to-promise date with supply chain and schedule delivery to customer location including carrier assignment.

activities: Run ATP check in SAP MM to confirm stock availability
Assign delivery date based on ATP result and carrier lead time
Create outbound delivery document in SAP SD
Notify customer of confirmed delivery date via portal or email
Coordinate with warehouse for pick scheduling
Run advanced ATP check against confirmed stock, production, and purchase order supply
Confirm requested delivery date or propose earliest alternative delivery date
Reserve stock and create delivery scheduling agreement in SAP S/4HANA
Trigger rescheduling workflow when ATP result conflicts with customer expectation
Communicate confirmed delivery date to customer service for order acknowledgement

act_otc_pick_pack_dispatch.name: Pick, Pack, and Dispatch Goods
act_otc_pick_pack_dispatch.description: Execute warehouse pick and pack operations and hand goods to carrier for delivery to customer.

activities: Execute transfer order pick in SAP WM or EWM
Confirm picked quantities against delivery document
Pack goods according to shipping specifications
Post goods issue in SAP to trigger inventory reduction
Hand over to carrier and capture proof of dispatch

act_otc_generate_invoice.name: Generate and Issue Customer Invoice
act_otc_generate_invoice.description: Create and issue invoice to customer following goods despatch, applying correct pricing, tax, and entity determination.

activities: Trigger billing run from goods issue or milestone event
Determine correct legal entity, tax code, and output format
Generate invoice document in SAP Billing
Transmit invoice via EDI, e-invoicing platform, or print
Post invoice to accounts receivable and revenue accounts
Submit invoice to country-specific tax authority portal via SAP Document Compliance
Validate invoice against jurisdiction-specific schema and mandatory field requirements
Receive and store tax authority clearance token or acknowledgement
Handle rejection responses and trigger invoice correction workflow
Archive compliant e-invoice document with audit trail for statutory retention period

act_otc_manage_collections.name: Manage Collections and Dunning
act_otc_manage_collections.description: Monitor overdue receivables, execute dunning programmes, and escalate high-risk accounts to credit management.

activities: Run daily overdue receivables report from SAP FSCM
Execute automated dunning letters at configured intervals
Contact customers directly for high-value overdue accounts
Escalate unresolved accounts to legal or collections agency
Record collection activities and commitments in FSCM worklist

act_otc_reconcile_apply_cash.name: Reconcile and Apply Cash Receipts
act_otc_reconcile_apply_cash.description: Match incoming payments to open invoices and post cash application to clear accounts receivable.

activities: Import bank statement and payment advices into SAP
Auto-match payments to open invoices using remittance data
Manually resolve unmatched payments using lockbox details
Post cash application and clear open items in SAP FICO
Escalate unresolved items to credit controller for investigation
Ingest bank statement and remittance data from multiple formats and channels
Apply ML matching algorithm to propose payment-to-invoice assignments
Auto-post high-confidence matches within configured tolerance thresholds
Route low-confidence matches to manual review worklist with suggested assignments
Generate unmatched payment exception report for escalation to collections team

act_otc_handle_disputes_returns.name: Handle Invoice Disputes and Returns
act_otc_handle_disputes_returns.description: Resolve customer invoice disputes and process approved returns or credit notes to maintain customer relationship and accurate AR.

activities: Log customer dispute against open invoice in FSCM dispute case
Investigate root cause: pricing error, short delivery, or quality issue
Coordinate resolution with sales, logistics, or quality teams
Issue credit note or corrected invoice upon resolution
Close dispute case and update customer communication log
Open structured dispute case in SAP FSCM with classification, amount, and responsible party
Route dispute to owning team based on dispute reason code and value threshold
Track dispute status, SLA countdown, and escalation triggers in unified worklist
Coordinate evidence gathering from sales, logistics, and quality teams within case
Close dispute with approved credit note posting or payment confirmation and audit record

act_p2p_create_requisition.name: Create and Approve Purchase Requisition
act_p2p_create_requisition.description: Initiates procurement process through self-service requisition with workflow-based approval against spend authority matrix.

activities: Create purchase requisition from catalogue item or free-text description with cost centre assignment
Attach business justification and budget confirmation to requisition record
Route requisition through spend-authority-based approval workflow
Monitor approval status and chase overdue approvals within SLA
Convert approved requisition to purchase order or sourcing event
Classify requisition against spend category taxonomy for analytics capture
Flag requisition as maverick spend if outside preferred supplier or contract
Validate requisition against category strategy and sourcing policy

act_p2p_issue_purchase_order.name: Issue Purchase Order to Supplier
act_p2p_issue_purchase_order.description: Converts approved requisition into a legally binding purchase order and transmits to supplier with acknowledgement tracking.

activities: Create purchase order with confirmed pricing, delivery date, and terms from contract or spot negotiation
Transmit PO to supplier via EDI, Ariba Network, or email with confirmation request
Record supplier order acknowledgement and confirmed delivery date against PO
Process PO change orders when delivery date, quantity, or price requires revision
Escalate unacknowledged POs beyond SLA to vendor manager for follow-up
Log PO issuance event against supplier scorecard for delivery performance tracking
Validate supplier is on approved vendor list and has current compliance certifications

act_p2p_receive_goods_services.name: Receive Goods or Confirm Service Delivery
act_p2p_receive_goods_services.description: Records goods receipt or service entry sheet in SAP S/4HANA MM to confirm delivery against purchase order.

activities: Post goods receipt in SAP against purchase order line items with quantity and quality confirmation
Record partial deliveries and update open PO quantity accordingly
Create service entry sheet for service-based POs upon completion confirmation
Flag delivery shortfalls, damages, and quality rejections against PO record
Trigger returns and debit memo process for rejected goods
Record on-time delivery result against PO due date for supplier scorecard
Capture quality rejection data for supplier performance review

act_p2p_process_supplier_invoice.name: Process and Match Supplier Invoice
act_p2p_process_supplier_invoice.description: Receives supplier invoice and performs automated three-way match against PO and goods receipt, routing exceptions for resolution.

activities: Ingest supplier invoice via OCR capture, EDI, or supplier portal submission
Execute automated three-way match against PO price, quantity, and goods receipt
Post matched invoice to accounting with GL account and cost object determination
Route mismatched invoices to exception worklist with mismatch reason and suggested resolution
Communicate invoice status and payment schedule to supplier on request
Validate invoice spend category classification for analytics accuracy
Flag invoices without backing PO as maverick spend for management reporting

act_p2p_execute_payment.name: Execute Supplier Payment Run
act_p2p_execute_payment.description: Runs automated payment proposal and executes payment to suppliers within agreed terms via SAP S/4HANA FI-AP.

activities: Generate payment proposal run for invoices due within payment terms window
Review and approve payment proposal, excluding blocked or disputed invoices
Execute payment run and transmit payment files to bank via SAP Bank Communication Management
Post payment clearing entries and update supplier open item ledger
Reconcile bank confirmation against payment run and resolve exceptions

act_fcr_execute_period_close.name: Execute Period-End Close
act_fcr_execute_period_close.description: Orchestrates the financial period-end close sequence across all entities, managing task dependencies and sign-off using SAP Financial Closing Cockpit.

activities: Activate period close task list in SAP Financial Closing Cockpit for all in-scope entities
Monitor task completion status and chase overdue items against close calendar
Post accruals, prepayments, and depreciation runs for the closing period
Reconcile sub-ledgers (AR, AP, Asset Accounting) to general ledger balances
Obtain entity controller sign-off and lock posting period in SAP

act_fcr_reconcile_intercompany.name: Reconcile Intercompany Balances
act_fcr_reconcile_intercompany.description: Matches and eliminates intercompany trading balances across all Ofluv legal entities prior to group consolidation.

activities: Run automated intercompany matching against counterparty balances across all entities
Identify and classify unmatched differences by root cause (timing, FX, missing postings)
Coordinate resolution of matched differences with entity controllers within SLA
Post intercompany elimination journals for confirmed matched balances
Escalate unresolved differences above materiality threshold to group controller
Validate intercompany reconciliation completion as close checklist gate
Approve intercompany elimination postings before consolidation run

act_fcr_consolidate_group.name: Consolidate Group Financial Statements
act_fcr_consolidate_group.description: Produces consolidated group P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow using SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting with automated eliminations.

activities: Load entity trial balances into SAP Group Reporting consolidation unit
Run automated currency translation at applicable period-end rates
Execute intercompany elimination rules for trading, loans, and dividends
Calculate minority interest and equity method investment adjustments
Produce consolidated P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement for review

act_fcr_prepare_tax_filings.name: Prepare and Submit Tax Filings
act_fcr_prepare_tax_filings.description: Calculates tax provisions and prepares statutory tax filings for all jurisdictions using SAP Tax Compliance.

activities: Calculate current and deferred tax provisions from S/4HANA Universal Journal data
Prepare VAT/GST returns for each jurisdiction using SAP Tax Compliance
Generate transfer pricing documentation and country-by-country report
Submit statutory tax filings via jurisdiction-specific e-filing integration
Maintain tax audit trail and supporting documentation for statutory retention

act_fcr_publish_reports.name: Publish Management and Board Reports
act_fcr_publish_reports.description: Delivers management accounts, KPI dashboards, and board reporting packs using SAP Analytics Cloud.

activities: Publish P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow actuals vs budget vs prior year in SAP Analytics Cloud
Produce KPI variance commentary and exception highlights for management review
Update rolling 3-month financial forecast with latest actuals and trading assumptions
Distribute board reporting pack with narrative, financials, and forward outlook
Respond to ad hoc queries from CFO and business unit leadership on financial results
Validate published figures against signed-off consolidation output
Approve group accounts for external publication and audit submission

act_dsp_generate_demand_forecast.name: Generate and Review Statistical Demand Forecast
act_dsp_generate_demand_forecast.description: Produces SKU-level demand forecast using SAP IBP statistical algorithms, incorporating market intelligence and consensus adjustment.

activities: Run statistical forecast models in SAP IBP using historical demand, seasonality, and trend algorithms
Apply promotion uplift and new product introduction adjustments to baseline forecast
Incorporate market intelligence and sales team input through consensus planning workflow
Identify and correct demand outliers and data anomalies before forecast publication
Publish approved 24-month rolling demand forecast to supply planning
Update safety stock calculations based on revised forecast error and service level targets
Flag SKUs where forecast volatility requires inventory policy review

act_dsp_generate_supply_plan.name: Generate Unconstrained Supply Plan
act_dsp_generate_supply_plan.description: Translates demand forecast into supply requirements across the network using SAP IBP Supply planning engine.

activities: Run supply network planning engine in SAP IBP to generate replenishment requirements
Optimise inventory deployment across distribution centres against service level targets
Identify supply shortfalls and excess positions by SKU and location
Generate supplier purchase requirements and production work orders for planning period
Highlight capacity constraints and supply risks for S&OP review
Apply safety stock and reorder point parameters to supply plan generation
Review excess inventory recommendations against write-down thresholds

act_dsp_run_sop.name: Run Monthly S&OP Process
act_dsp_run_sop.description: Facilitates executive S&OP to reconcile demand, supply, inventory, and financial plans using SAP IBP S&OP scenario modelling.

activities: Prepare S&OP input pack with demand vs supply gap analysis and scenario options
Facilitate demand review, supply review, and pre-S&OP meetings to resolve imbalances
Model supply scenarios in SAP IBP to evaluate trade-offs between service level, cost, and inventory
Present recommended plan and exception decisions to executive S&OP for approval
Publish approved demand, supply, and inventory plan for execution by planning teams

act_dsp_release_production_schedule.name: Release Master Production Schedule
act_dsp_release_production_schedule.description: Converts approved supply plan into feasible production schedule considering capacity and material constraints in SAP PP/DS.

activities: Convert approved supply plan into time-phased production orders in SAP S/4HANA PP/DS
Level production schedule against confirmed plant capacity and shift patterns
Resolve material availability exceptions before releasing schedule to shop floor
Communicate frozen schedule horizon and change freeze rules to production teams
Monitor schedule adherence daily and update rolling MPS for remaining planning period
Validate production schedule output aligns with distribution replenishment requirements
Adjust supply network plan where MPS capacity constraints create delivery risk

act_dsp_manage_inventory_policy.name: Review and Maintain Inventory Policy
act_dsp_manage_inventory_policy.description: Reviews and updates safety stock levels, replenishment parameters, and inventory targets by SKU using SAP IBP Inventory optimisation.

activities: Run inventory optimisation model in SAP IBP to calculate optimal safety stock by SKU
Review ABC/XYZ classification of SKUs and apply appropriate replenishment strategy
Identify slow-moving and obsolete inventory candidates for markdown or write-off
Update reorder points, min/max levels, and lot size parameters in SAP master data
Report excess and obsolete inventory value to finance for provision review
Validate revised inventory targets against network service level and cost objectives

cap_order_management.name: Order Management
cap_order_management.description: Ability to capture, validate, and maintain customer orders across all channels and regions with full SAP SD integration.

cap_credit_risk_control.name: Credit Risk Control
cap_credit_risk_control.description: Ability to assess, monitor, and enforce customer credit exposure limits in real time across all order and receivables activity.

cap_fulfilment_coordination.name: Fulfilment Coordination
cap_fulfilment_coordination.description: Ability to coordinate available-to-promise checks, delivery scheduling, warehouse execution, and carrier handover.

cap_billing_invoicing.name: Billing & Invoicing
cap_billing_invoicing.description: Ability to generate accurate, compliant customer invoices across all legal entities, tax regimes, and output formats.

cap_collections_management.name: Collections Management
cap_collections_management.description: Ability to monitor overdue receivables, execute dunning programmes, and manage escalation of high-risk accounts.

cap_revenue_accounting.name: Revenue Accounting
cap_revenue_accounting.description: Ability to apply cash receipts, reconcile bank statements, and maintain accurate accounts receivable subledger.

cap_customer_master_governance.name: Customer Master Governance
cap_customer_master_governance.description: Maintains accuracy and completeness of global customer master data in SAP S/4HANA SD, including sold-to/ship-to hierarchy, pricing conditions, and legal entity assignments.

cap_available_to_promise.name: Available-to-Promise (ATP)
cap_available_to_promise.description: Determines product availability and delivery dates using SAP S/4HANA Advanced ATP, incorporating stock, production orders, and purchasing documents in real time.

cap_einvoicing_compliance.name: E-Invoicing & Tax Compliance
cap_einvoicing_compliance.description: Manages mandatory e-invoicing submissions and tax determination across 14 jurisdictions using SAP Document Compliance and country-specific localisation.

cap_cash_application_automation.name: Cash Application Automation
cap_cash_application_automation.description: Applies ML-assisted matching of incoming payments to open receivables using SAP FSCM, reducing manual reconciliation and improving auto-match rates.

cap_dispute_case_management.name: Dispute Case Management
cap_dispute_case_management.description: Manages invoice disputes and credit claims through structured workflow in SAP FSCM Dispute Management, providing end-to-end visibility and SLA tracking.

cap_purchase_requisitioning.name: Purchase Requisitioning
cap_purchase_requisitioning.description: Manages self-service purchase requisition creation and approval workflows in SAP S/4HANA MM, including catalogue-based and free-text procurement.

cap_po_management.name: Purchase Order Management
cap_po_management.description: Creates, transmits, and manages purchase orders in SAP S/4HANA MM, including version management, acknowledgement tracking, and change order workflow.

cap_supplier_invoice_processing.name: Supplier Invoice Processing
cap_supplier_invoice_processing.description: Processes supplier invoices via SAP Document Management and three-way match, automating PO/GR/invoice reconciliation and exception handling.

cap_accounts_payable.name: Accounts Payable & Payment Run
cap_accounts_payable.description: Manages payment terms, payment proposals, and payment runs in SAP S/4HANA FI-AP, including bank communication and payment status tracking.

cap_supplier_performance.name: Supplier Performance Management
cap_supplier_performance.description: Tracks on-time delivery, quality rejection rates, and commercial compliance for strategic suppliers using SAP Ariba and S/4HANA analytics.

cap_spend_analytics.name: Spend Analytics & Compliance
cap_spend_analytics.description: Provides category-level spend visibility, PO compliance rates, and maverick spend identification using SAP Spend Control Tower.

cap_period_end_close.name: Period-End Close Orchestration
cap_period_end_close.description: Manages the financial period-end close process using SAP Financial Closing Cockpit, coordinating task sequences, dependencies, and sign-off across entities.

cap_intercompany_reconciliation.name: Intercompany Reconciliation
cap_intercompany_reconciliation.description: Automates matching and elimination of intercompany balances across Ofluv legal entities using SAP Advanced Intercompany Reconciliation.

cap_group_consolidation.name: Group Consolidation & Reporting
cap_group_consolidation.description: Consolidates group financial statements across 14 legal entities using SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting with automated eliminations and minority interest calculations.

cap_tax_reporting.name: Tax Reporting & Compliance
cap_tax_reporting.description: Manages statutory tax filings, transfer pricing documentation, and tax provision calculation using SAP Tax Compliance and country localisation.

cap_management_reporting.name: Management Reporting & Analytics
cap_management_reporting.description: Delivers management accounts, KPI dashboards, and variance analysis using SAP Analytics Cloud integrated with S/4HANA Universal Journal.

cap_demand_forecasting.name: Demand Forecasting
cap_demand_forecasting.description: Generates statistical demand forecasts using SAP IBP Demand with ML-based algorithms, incorporating market intelligence, seasonality, and promotion uplift.

cap_supply_network_planning.name: Supply Network Planning
cap_supply_network_planning.description: Optimises supply network inventory positions and replenishment plans across Ofluv distribution centres using SAP IBP Supply.

cap_sales_operations_planning.name: Sales & Operations Planning
cap_sales_operations_planning.description: Facilitates monthly S&OP process to align demand, supply, and financial plans using SAP IBP S&OP with integrated scenario modelling.

cap_master_production_scheduling.name: Master Production Scheduling
cap_master_production_scheduling.description: Translates approved supply plan into feasible production schedule considering capacity constraints using SAP S/4HANA PP/DS.

cap_inventory_policy.name: Inventory Policy Management
cap_inventory_policy.description: Defines and maintains safety stock policies, replenishment parameters, and inventory targets by SKU and location using SAP IBP Inventory.

out_dsp_demand_forecast_published.name: Statistical demand forecast published and reviewed

out_dsp_sop_aligned.name: Demand, supply, and financial plan aligned through S&OP

out_dsp_mps_released.name: Master production schedule released to manufacturing

out_dsp_inventory_targets_set.name: Inventory policy and safety stock targets confirmed

metric_otc_order_to_invoice_days.name: Order-to-Invoice Cycle Time
metric_otc_order_to_invoice_days.description: Average days from customer order receipt to invoice issuance

metric_otc_dso.name: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
metric_otc_dso.description: Average days to collect payment after invoice issuance

metric_otc_first_pass_invoice_accuracy.name: First-Pass Invoice Accuracy
metric_otc_first_pass_invoice_accuracy.description: Percentage of invoices issued without error or dispute

metric_otc_collection_rate.name: Collection Rate
metric_otc_collection_rate.description: Percentage of invoiced revenue collected within payment terms

metric_otc_order_error_rate.name: Order Entry Error Rate
metric_otc_order_error_rate.description: Percentage of orders requiring correction after initial entry due to data quality issues.

metric_otc_credit_decision_latency.name: Credit Decision Latency
metric_otc_credit_decision_latency.description: Time from order submission to credit approval decision. Current overnight batch vs target real-time.

metric_otc_einvoice_compliance_rate.name: E-Invoice Compliance Rate
metric_otc_einvoice_compliance_rate.description: Percentage of invoices successfully submitted to tax authorities within statutory deadlines.

metric_otc_cash_auto_match_rate.name: Cash Auto-Match Rate
metric_otc_cash_auto_match_rate.description: Percentage of incoming payments automatically matched to open receivables without manual intervention.

metric_otc_dispute_resolution_days.name: Dispute Resolution Cycle Time
metric_otc_dispute_resolution_days.description: Average calendar days from dispute opening to resolution and credit note issuance.

metric_p2p_po_cycle_time.name: Purchase Order Cycle Time
metric_p2p_po_cycle_time.description: Time from approved purchase requisition to issued purchase order.

metric_p2p_invoice_match_rate.name: First-Pass Invoice Match Rate
metric_p2p_invoice_match_rate.description: Percentage of supplier invoices matched automatically on first attempt without manual intervention.

metric_p2p_payment_on_time.name: On-Time Payment Rate
metric_p2p_payment_on_time.description: Percentage of supplier invoices paid within agreed payment terms.

metric_p2p_po_compliance.name: PO-Backed Spend Rate
metric_p2p_po_compliance.description: Percentage of addressable spend backed by a purchase order at time of invoice receipt.

metric_p2p_supplier_otd.name: Supplier On-Time Delivery Rate
metric_p2p_supplier_otd.description: Percentage of purchase order line items delivered within the confirmed delivery date.

metric_fcr_close_cycle_days.name: Financial Close Cycle Time
metric_fcr_close_cycle_days.description: Calendar days from period end to published group management accounts.

metric_fcr_ic_reconciliation_rate.name: Intercompany Auto-Reconciliation Rate
metric_fcr_ic_reconciliation_rate.description: Percentage of intercompany balances automatically matched without manual adjustment.

metric_fcr_restatement_count.name: Period Restatement Count
metric_fcr_restatement_count.description: Average number of prior-period restatements per financial year across all entities.

metric_fcr_tax_filing_compliance.name: Tax Filing On-Time Compliance
metric_fcr_tax_filing_compliance.description: Percentage of statutory tax filings submitted on time across all jurisdictions.

metric_fcr_forecast_accuracy.name: Rolling Forecast Accuracy
metric_fcr_forecast_accuracy.description: Percentage accuracy of 3-month rolling financial forecast vs actual results.

metric_dsp_forecast_accuracy.name: Demand Forecast Accuracy (WMAPE)
metric_dsp_forecast_accuracy.description: Weighted Mean Absolute Percentage Error of 13-week statistical demand forecast vs actuals.

metric_dsp_inventory_turns.name: Inventory Turns
metric_dsp_inventory_turns.description: Annual inventory turns calculated as COGS divided by average inventory value.

metric_dsp_service_level.name: Customer Service Level (OTIF)
metric_dsp_service_level.description: On-Time In-Full delivery rate against confirmed customer delivery dates.

metric_dsp_excess_inventory.name: Excess & Obsolete Inventory
metric_dsp_excess_inventory.description: Value of slow-moving and obsolete inventory as a percentage of total inventory value.

metric_dsp_plan_adherence.name: Production Plan Adherence
metric_dsp_plan_adherence.description: Percentage of master production schedule executed within the confirmed planning period.

ctrl_otc_order_completeness_check.name: Order Completeness Gate
ctrl_otc_order_completeness_check.description: Mandatory field validation on customer order before progression to credit check

ctrl_otc_credit_block_rule.name: Credit Block Rule
ctrl_otc_credit_block_rule.description: Automatic order block triggered when customer exposure exceeds approved credit limit

ctrl_otc_goods_issue_confirmation.name: Goods Issue Confirmation
ctrl_otc_goods_issue_confirmation.description: Warehouse confirmation of goods issue required before billing document creation

ctrl_otc_tax_determination.name: Tax Determination Check
ctrl_otc_tax_determination.description: Automated tax code determination validated against ship-to country and product tax classification

ctrl_otc_invoice_approval_rule.name: High-Value Invoice Approval
ctrl_otc_invoice_approval_rule.description: Invoices above threshold require billing manager approval before transmission

ctrl_otc_dunning_level_rule.name: Dunning Escalation Rule
ctrl_otc_dunning_level_rule.description: Automated escalation to next dunning level based on days overdue and account risk class

ctrl_otc_cash_application_tolerance.name: Cash Application Tolerance
